title: Where on Earth?
desc: Borders that make no sense, records nobody asked for & map madness

questions.q: Which country has the most time zones — and it's not Russia?
questions.a: France — 12 time zones (thanks to overseas territories)

questions.q: The shortest scheduled flight in the world is in Scotland. How long does it take?
questions.a: About 57 seconds — Westray to Papa Westray in Orkney

questions.q: Which African country has more pyramids than Egypt?
questions.a: Sudan — over 200, compared to Egypt's roughly 130

questions.q: Point Nemo is the farthest spot from any land on Earth. What's the closest human presence?
questions.a: Astronauts on the ISS — it orbits closer than any landmass

questions.q: Only one country in the world has a flag that isn't rectangular or square. Which?
Canada has more lakes than the rest of the world combined — true or false?
questions.a: True — over 60% of the world's lakes are in Canada

questions.q: Two islands 3.8 km apart have a time difference of 21 hours. What are they?
questions.a: Big Diomede (Russia) and Little Diomede (USA) — straddling the International Date Line

questions.q: Which tiny country sits entirely inside the city of Rome?
Mount Chimborazo in Ecuador is technically closer to space than Everest. Why?
questions.a: Earth's equatorial bulge — Chimborazo's peak is farther from Earth's centre

questions.q: What is the only US state whose name you can type on a single row of a keyboard?
questions.a: Alaska — A, L, A, S, K, A all sit on the top row
